title: ARCADE: RUN END ALWAYS REACHES PLAYER 2
why: His yes to the five recommendations for the Halloween party mode, arcade26, a low finding of the arcade review. When the run ended on player 1, player 2 was told twice: once on the link between the two windows and once on the co-op link. If the co-op word came first, player 2 thought player 1 had left and picked the raid up as its own, so the run end after it was ignored and player 2 kept playing alone. Now player 1 marks that co-op word as a run end, and player 2 stops on whichever word comes first and goes back to its attract. Player 1 also says it again every half second until player 2 answers or 3 seconds pass. If player 1 window really goes away, player 2 still picks the raid up, as he ruled. Normal raids are untouched.
now: In the arcade, ending the run on player 1 always sends player 2 back to its attract.
